look: Crag Troll, a B-rank GKOM variant from the Crag Trolls family: lanky stooped troll whose wounds are knit shut by crystal. Family anatomy: huge stooped ogres and trolls with craggy rock-like skin and crude clubs. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: half the body armoured in GKOM crystal, natural patches between the plates; the crystals are iron-grey crag crystal. A softball-sized GKOM core orb, dark crimson with a steady pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, strong stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
